where_we_are: Challenges A and B are done and delivered (repository public, email to the panel sent). Measured behaviour when the model API is down: the scan stops with an unhandled error, the ledger keeps the decisions already made and closes the run with the error, and the report refuses to be written; only an answer that cannot be read ends in Needs review.
